experiment: E2C-v3 Phase B — Composition Repair Results

failure_classification.phase_a: Case B — composition failure (correct code doesn't rescue M)
failure_classification.phase_b: Case Other — composition rescue succeeded but alignment insufficient

interpretation.summary: Composition repair partially succeeded. The model learned to use image+correct code to produce the right alias (58.1%), but through a shortcut: the model uses the code as a hint for image interpretation rather than establishing a genuine X->C->Y mediated route.
evidence_for_composition: change_rate increased from 27.6% to 86.5% (code strongly influences output)
code_target_alignment increased from 0.1% to 31.0% (wrong codes partially followed)
evidence_against_genuine_mediation: code_only_accuracy DROPPED from 60% to 10% (catastrophic forgetting of C->Y)
img_to_code = 0% (model cannot infer code from image — X->C route absent)
code_target_alignment = 31% (far below the 80% threshold for genuine mediation)
The model uses code as an image-interpretation hint, not as a causal mediator
interpretation.diagnosis: The model learned a code-conditioned image classification shortcut: given image + code, it uses the code to disambiguate the image, but this is not mediated through X->C->Y. The X->C route (image-to-code inference) was never established.
next_steps: Option 1: Pre-train X->C separately before adding composition (curriculum)
Option 2: Increase XC loss weight to ensure image-to-code is learned
Option 3: Use a simpler code representation that the model can learn from images
Option 4: Freeze C->Y from Phase A and only train X->C + (X,C)->Y jointly
